data.name: Farouk
data.gender_notes: Farouk is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The owner of the great fortress
data.long_meaning: The name Farouk is derived from the Arabic root words ‘Far’ (to protect, preserve) and ‘Ruk’ (castle, fortress). This evocative name signifies the one who owns or protects a great fortress, a stronghold, or a powerful kingdom. In Islamic history, many notable figures have borne this name, including Sultan Farouk I of Egypt (r. 1936-1952).
data.spiritual_meaning: Protector of the faith and people
data.etymology: Farouk belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The owner of the great fortress.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farouk total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: فاروق
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الفرق بين الحق والباطل
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاروق هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: من يفرق بين الحق والباطل، ويعرف بالفرقان. ورد اسم فاروق في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران آية ١٧٤، قال تعالى: ﴿فَإِذْ هَمَ أَصْحَابُ الْفِتْيَةِ بِمَضَائِهِ فَأَطَلَبَ الْمَلِكُ أَمَرَ أَهْلِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَأَظْهَرَ الْحَقَّ وَأَبْطَلَ الْبَاطِلَ فَسُمِيَ فَارُوقًا﴾. يعتبر اسم فاروق من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في التراث الإسلامي و التاريخ العربي.

in_urdu.name: فاروق
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو حق اور باطل کے درمیان فرق کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاروق ایک مشہور عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'وہ شخص جو حق اور باطل کے درمیان فرق کرتا ہے'۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے، خاص طور پر سورہ آل عمران میں۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام عمر فاروق کے لیے استعمال ہوا ہے، جو خلفاء راشدہ کے دوسرے خلیفہ تھے۔ اس نام کا انتخاب کرنا والدین کے لیے فخر کا باعث ہے کیونکہ یہ اسلامی تاریخ میں ایک اہم مقام رکھتا ہے۔

in_english.name: Farouk
in_english.meaning: one who distinguishes between right and wrong
in_english.long_meaning: Farouk is a renowned Arabic name that means 'one who distinguishes between right and wrong'. The name originates from the Arabic root 'F-R-Q' which conveys the sense of differentiation or distinction. This name is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Imran. Historically, the name Farouk was associated with Umar ibn Al-Khattab, the second Caliph of Islam, who was known for his justice and ability to distinguish between truth and falsehood. The name holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing wisdom, justice, and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Farouk holds a rich cultural heritage, as it has been associated with the historical Sultan of Egypt, Farouk I, who ruled during a significant period of Egyptian history. This majestic title symbolizes resistance, power, and leadership, as well as the enduring legacy of Islamic civilization. Farouq is also a popular name across the Arabic world, contributing to a substantial cultural impact on the region and the diaspora.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Farouk, much like its historical figures, holds profound spiritual significance as it reminds those who bear it of their responsibility to protect, preserve, and strengthen their spiritual fortresses, whether that be their immediate family, wider community, or the global Muslim ummah. Farouk serves as a reminder that we must all be guardians and defenders of truth, virtue, and the teachings of Islam, ultimately striving towards personal and communal growth and success. The name offers an inspiring, powerful, and protective force that reflects the best aspects of human nature, perseverance, and strength.
